description: Comment on a public post; passing reply_to_comment_id replies to that specific comment (replying to a reply is allowed — you do not need to work out the nesting yourself). **Before sending, read the text back to the user verbatim for confirmation** — this speaks in the user's own name in public. Body must be non-empty and at most 500 characters.

post_id.description: Post id. The 8-character short id is enough; a full id or a post link also works

reply_to_comment_id.description: Id of the comment to reply to (the 8-character short id from get_post_replies is enough). Omit to post a new top-level comment

name: reply_to_post
title: Comment on a Post
